# simpleaudit-docs

Documentation for simpleaudit-docs

> https://github.com/SushantGautam/simpleaudit

## Guides

- [Quickstart](https://SushantGautam.github.io/simpleaudit-docs/guides/quickstart/): Run your first local audit via CLI and inspect generated results.
- [Installation](https://SushantGautam.github.io/simpleaudit-docs/guides/installation/): Install SimpleAudit and configure local model dependencies.
- [Architecture](https://SushantGautam.github.io/simpleaudit-docs/guides/architecture/): Understand the auditor, experiment, and result aggregation flow.
- [Key Ideas](https://SushantGautam.github.io/simpleaudit-docs/guides/key-ideas/): Learn how judges, scenarios, and visualization integrate.

## API Reference

- [simpleaudit](https://SushantGautam.github.io/simpleaudit-docs/reference/simpleaudit/): SimpleAudit - Lightweight AI Safety Auditing Framework
- [simpleaudit.cli](https://SushantGautam.github.io/simpleaudit-docs/reference/simpleaudit_cli/): CLI interface for SimpleAudit tools.
- [simpleaudit.experiment](https://SushantGautam.github.io/simpleaudit-docs/reference/simpleaudit_experiment/)
- [simpleaudit.judges](https://SushantGautam.github.io/simpleaudit-docs/reference/simpleaudit_judges/): Built-in judge configurations for SimpleAudit.
- [simpleaudit.judges.abstention](https://SushantGautam.github.io/simpleaudit-docs/reference/simpleaudit_judges_abstention/): Abstention judge configuration.
- [simpleaudit.judges.binary_abstention](https://SushantGautam.github.io/simpleaudit-docs/reference/simpleaudit_judges_binary_abstention/): Binary abstention judge — language-agnostic.
- [simpleaudit.judges.factuality](https://SushantGautam.github.io/simpleaudit-docs/reference/simpleaudit_judges_factuality/): Factuality judge configuration.
- [simpleaudit.judges.harm](https://SushantGautam.github.io/simpleaudit-docs/reference/simpleaudit_judges_harm/): Harm categorisation judge configuration.
- [simpleaudit.judges.helpfulness](https://SushantGautam.github.io/simpleaudit-docs/reference/simpleaudit_judges_helpfulness/): Helpfulness judge configuration.
- [simpleaudit.judges.helsedir_sexhealth_no](https://SushantGautam.github.io/simpleaudit-docs/reference/simpleaudit_judges_helsedir_sexhealth_no/): Helsedirektoratet sexual-health judge — generic variant.
- [simpleaudit.judges.helsedir_sexhealth_no_rag](https://SushantGautam.github.io/simpleaudit-docs/reference/simpleaudit_judges_helsedir_sexhealth_no_rag/): Helsedirektoratet sexual-health judge — RAG variant.
- [simpleaudit.judges.safety](https://SushantGautam.github.io/simpleaudit-docs/reference/simpleaudit_judges_safety/): Safety judge configuration.
- [simpleaudit.model_auditor](https://SushantGautam.github.io/simpleaudit-docs/reference/simpleaudit_model_auditor/): ModelAuditor for direct API-based model auditing.
- [simpleaudit.repeated_results](https://SushantGautam.github.io/simpleaudit-docs/reference/simpleaudit_repeated_results/): Repeated-run results for SimpleAudit.
- [simpleaudit.results](https://SushantGautam.github.io/simpleaudit-docs/reference/simpleaudit_results/): Results handling for SimpleAudit.
- [simpleaudit.scenarios](https://SushantGautam.github.io/simpleaudit-docs/reference/simpleaudit_scenarios/): Built-in scenario packs for SimpleAudit.
- [simpleaudit.scenarios.bullshitbench_health](https://SushantGautam.github.io/simpleaudit-docs/reference/simpleaudit_scenarios_bullshitbench_health/)
- [simpleaudit.scenarios.bullshitbench_v1_v2](https://SushantGautam.github.io/simpleaudit-docs/reference/simpleaudit_scenarios_bullshitbench_v1_v2/)
- [simpleaudit.scenarios.health](https://SushantGautam.github.io/simpleaudit-docs/reference/simpleaudit_scenarios_health/): Healthcare domain scenarios.
- [simpleaudit.scenarios.hei_refusal](https://SushantGautam.github.io/simpleaudit-docs/reference/simpleaudit_scenarios_hei_refusal/): Hei refusal scenario pack.
- [simpleaudit.scenarios.helpmed](https://SushantGautam.github.io/simpleaudit-docs/reference/simpleaudit_scenarios_helpmed/): HelpMed domain scenarios.
- [simpleaudit.scenarios.nav_aap](https://SushantGautam.github.io/simpleaudit-docs/reference/simpleaudit_scenarios_nav_aap/): NAV AAP (Arbeidsavklaringspenger) scenario pack.
- [simpleaudit.scenarios.rag](https://SushantGautam.github.io/simpleaudit-docs/reference/simpleaudit_scenarios_rag/): RAG-specific scenarios.
- [simpleaudit.scenarios.safety](https://SushantGautam.github.io/simpleaudit-docs/reference/simpleaudit_scenarios_safety/): General AI safety scenarios.
- [simpleaudit.scenarios.skatteetaten](https://SushantGautam.github.io/simpleaudit-docs/reference/simpleaudit_scenarios_skatteetaten/): Skatteetaten (Norwegian Tax Administration) scenario pack.
- [simpleaudit.scenarios.system_prompt](https://SushantGautam.github.io/simpleaudit-docs/reference/simpleaudit_scenarios_system_prompt/): System prompt testing scenarios.
- [simpleaudit.scenarios.ung](https://SushantGautam.github.io/simpleaudit-docs/reference/simpleaudit_scenarios_ung/)
- [simpleaudit.utils](https://SushantGautam.github.io/simpleaudit-docs/reference/simpleaudit_utils/): Utility functions for SimpleAudit.

## Agent Skill

- [SKILL.md](https://SushantGautam.github.io/simpleaudit-docs/SKILL.md): Agent skill for generating, maintaining, and validating this project's documentation.
